known_issues.summary: Static FastThreadLocal<Map<String, Block>> keyed by path: a second instance reuses the Block, skips setup, bufferSize stays -1 and ByteBuffer.limit(-1) throws
The per-thread cache of read-ahead blocks is unbounded and never cleaned up (slow heap leak)
Compressed scan readers go through the chunk cache and pollute it; the fix touches ChunkCache.java, which this diff does not
Readers are allocated per scan and discarded; thread-local memory must be returned promptly when the file handle closes
